benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.1
benchmarks.description: Terminal-based agent tasks; model, agent harness and effort are part of each result.
benchmarks.costMethod: Derived mean per trial: reported total evaluation cost divided by reported trial count. Raw totals retained; not a per-success cost.
benchmarks.timeMethod: Source-reported average trial duration in seconds.
benchmarks.selectionMethod: Primary is the first source-ranked configuration for each model; alternate runs remain separate.

benchmarks.name: SWE-rebench · May–July 2026
benchmarks.description: 111 problems from 65 repositories in the source-selected date window. Model-only rows; standalone agent products excluded.
benchmarks.costMethod: Source-reported mean cost per problem, including source cache usage.
benchmarks.timeMethod: Not published in the imported table.
benchmarks.selectionMethod: All 13 model rows with numeric scores in the visible time window.

benchmarks.name: Epoch Capabilities Index
benchmarks.description: A capability estimate fitted across benchmarks; ECI is unbounded and is not a percentage.
benchmarks.costMethod: No task costs are reported in this dataset.
benchmarks.timeMethod: No task durations are reported in this dataset.
benchmarks.selectionMethod: 64 models: every model in the CSV released on or after 1 June 2026, and earlier models the app already lists. The CSV row named DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (released 9 September 2026) is left out because that name is the app identity for the later 1017 release.
